purpose: Constrain analyst output to structured tags, mechanism labels, evidence gaps, and review fields. The analyst must not invent final probabilities.

analyst_output.event_stage: accumulation | euphoria | first_cracks | panic | capitulation | recovery | unclear
analyst_output.trigger_type: technology | regulatory | financial | geopolitical | commodity | credit | policy | other
analyst_output.market_reaction_so_far: ignored | high_volatility | one_way_move | reversal | dispersion | unclear
